definition: Daily monetary-policy surprises and decomposed monetary-policy and central-bank-information shocks around policy announcements; 29 country-market observations linked to 20 monetary authorities
coverage: 2000-2022; 29 countries; 20 central banks; euro-area markets share ECB authority
license: Research-paper metadata is public; underlying Refinitiv/Bloomberg inputs and reuse rights require separate verification
transformation: Use identified monetary-policy shock epsilon_MP as primary treatment; preserve raw surprise, orthogonalized surprise and CBI shock separately; do not count euro-area national markets as independent shock authorities

definition: Bitcoin exchange trading volume in local-currency pairs used as a proxy for crypto adoption; direction of trade is unobserved
coverage: 56 exchanges operating in 47 countries; 15 advanced and 32 emerging/developing economies
license: Underlying series compiled from Bitcoinity, Coin.dance and Bitcoincharts; redistribution rights and historical availability require verification
transformation: Keep as btc_exchange_volume_proxy; never relabel as payment share or btc_use_share; document possible double counting and exchange coverage

definition: Relative search interest for the query Bitcoin, normalized to a 0-100 scale relative to selected geography and time window
coverage: IMF Fintech Note reports 145 countries; study period 2013-2019
license: Google Trends terms apply; query parameters and extraction date must be archived
transformation: Treat as attention/search-interest proxy only; not ownership, payment use, transaction volume, or monetary substitution

definition: Central bank policy rate selected in consultation with central banks; may be target, repo, discount or best available traded rate; metadata document instrument breaks
coverage: More than 40 advanced and emerging market economies; historical series vary by country
license: BIS terms of permitted use apply; check https://data.bis.org/help/legal
transformation: Use as policy stance/control and for validation, not as exogenous policy shock; retain series metadata and instrument-break flags

definition: Country and aggregate macroeconomic indicators including national accounts, inflation, unemployment, balance of payments and fiscal measures
license: IMF dataset terms apply; verify series-specific reuse conditions
transformation: Use only documented controls; preserve indicator codes, vintage, units and revisions; do not silently interpolate

definition: Nationally representative survey indicators on account ownership, digital payments, saving, borrowing and financial resilience; not a Bitcoin-specific survey
license: World Bank dataset terms apply; verify downloadable file terms
transformation: Use as broad digital-finance context or control only; never substitute for Bitcoin payment use

definition: Composite crypto activity index combining service inflows, domestic P2P transfers, cross-border transfers and on-chain balances; country attribution partly uses web-traffic allocation
unit: normalized index 0-1 and underlying modeled flows
license: Commercial proprietary methodology/data; public report describes methodology; redistribution rights not established
transformation: All-crypto composite, not Bitcoin-specific; includes balances and institutional/service flows; use only as external robustness/context proxy if licensing permits

provider: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
definition: US adult survey distinguishes crypto investment/holding from buying goods or making payments and sending money to friends/family; includes Bitcoin or Ethereum wording
license: Federal Reserve publication; survey microdata access and reuse conditions to be checked separately
transformation: Measurement validation only; crypto not Bitcoin-only and single-country series cannot support cross-country panel
